title: Rainfront Rammer: The Machine That Moves a Storm
seo_description: What if a colossal machine could physically move a rainfront? Rainfront Rammer imagines an 8-kilometer articulated weather-moving engine using rotating traction drums, massive torque systems, and telescoping pressure fins to push directly into a storm.
pinned_comment: Could a machine this massive really move an entire storm? 🌧️ What would you call it? 👇
